title: The Balance Property: The Constrained Case, with a View on Risk Sharing
summary: The balance property is an important property of fitted statistical models deployed for insurance pricing. It guarantees that the total actuarial price in the fitted model is equal to the totally observed loss used to fit the model. This can be seen as an in-sample global unbiasedness property. Maximum likelihood fitted generalized linear models (GLMs) with canonical links automatically fulfill the balance property.
